text: The Aldermoor hoard is now on long-term display at the Lathe Street Gallery, according to a transfer notice released Tuesday by the Department for Heritage and confirmed by gallery director Elaine Voss. The notice says the trove of bronze age ornaments, coins and worked amber, recovered near Aldermoor in 2019, was formally handed over after conservation in April. Ms Voss said the museum had taken possession of 184 catalogued items, including the so-called River Torque and a group of five stamped ingots. The department said the move followed a recommendation from the National Finds Panel and a six-month review of storage and public access options. Initial exhibition is due to open on 18 November.
